answer: Require each new identity to complete a sequential verifiable-delay puzzle bound to its public key before it can transact: the puzzle takes hours, cannot be sped up by parallel machines, and is checked instantly by peers. Like a lantern lit one at a time, each identity must burn real time before joining; an atlas of registered keys records who has completed it, and an onyx-hard proof cannot be copied to a second identity. Spawning ten thousand fakes then costs ten thousand puzzle runs, while one honest agent pays once.
